title: Google DeepMind develops watermarks for AI-designed proteins
friendlyTitle: DeepMind can mark proteins designed by AI
summary: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a proof-of-concept system that embeds detectable signatures in AI-generated protein sequences and structures. Its laboratory tests found that watermarked binders retained biological function, while AlphaFold 3 structures remained accurate and detectable.
friendlySummary: DeepMind tested a hidden mark for proteins created with AI. The mark could still be found while the tested proteins continued to work normally.
whyItMatters: Reliable provenance could help DNA synthesis providers screen unfamiliar designs and help scientific databases distinguish synthetic entries from natural ones. The work is early and not tamper-proof, but it adds a practical verification layer as generative biology expands.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could help laboratories and safety teams check where a new protein design came from. It is an early safety tool, not a complete solution.
